title.en: Unit 2 Notes — Bolted and Welded Connections
title.gu: યુનિટ 2 Notes — Bolted અને Welded Connections

h.gu: 2.1 Connection ના પ્રકારો, bolts અને geometry

items.syllabus_item: 2.1 types of connections and bolts lap butt pitch tack edge gauge hole

body.en:
Connections transfer force between members and must provide a continuous load path. Lap joint: overlapping plates connected directly. Butt joint: plates meet end-to-end and are joined by one or two cover plates; the number of shear planes follows actual geometry. Connections may be bolted or welded, simple shear or moment-resisting, and concentric or eccentric.

Black bolts are ordinary unfinished bolts; turned bolts are accurately machined for close-fitting holes; HSFG bolts are pre-tensioned high-strength friction-grip bolts, with slip resistance designed according to the specified connection class and code. A property class 4.6 bolt has nominal ultimate strength fub = 400 MPa and nominal yield strength approximately 0.6fub = 240 MPa. Do not treat HSFG slip-critical resistance as ordinary bearing-bolt strength without the proper code provisions.

Pitch is centre-to-centre spacing of bolts in the load direction; gauge is the transverse spacing between bolt lines; end distance is along the force direction from bolt centre to end; edge distance is transverse to force. Hole diameter d₀ includes the specified clearance. Tack bolts keep parts together between main connections; their spacing and use depend on the member and relevant clause.
body.gu:
Connections members વચ્ચે force પહોંચાડી સતત load path આપે છે. Lap joint: Plates overlap થઈ સીધી જોડાય છે. Butt joint: Plates છેડે મળે છે અને એક અથવા બે cover plates થી જોડાય છે; shear planes ની સંખ્યા વાસ્તવિક geometry પરથી નક્કી થાય છે. Connections bolted અથવા welded, simple shear અથવા moment-resisting અને concentric અથવા eccentric હોઈ શકે છે.

Black bolts સામાન્ય unfinished bolts છે; turned bolts close-fitting holes માટે ચોક્કસ machining ધરાવે છે; HSFG bolts pre-tensioned high-strength friction-grip bolts છે, જેમનું slip resistance connection class અને code મુજબ design થાય છે. Property class 4.6 bolt ની nominal ultimate strength fub = 400 MPa અને nominal yield strength આશરે 0.6fub = 240 MPa છે. HSFG slip-critical resistance ને ordinary bearing-bolt strength ન માનો.

Pitch load દિશામાં bolt centres વચ્ચેનું અંતર; gauge bolt lines વચ્ચેનું transverse અંતર; end distance force દિશામાં centre થી plate ના છેડા સુધીનું અંતર; edge distance force ને transverse દિશામાં અંતર છે. Hole diameter d₀ માં specified clearance સામેલ છે. Tack bolts મુખ્ય connections વચ્ચે parts જોડે રાખે છે; તેમનું spacing અને ઉપયોગ member તથા સંબંધિત clause પર આધારિત છે.

items.syllabus_item: 2.1 minimum and maximum pitch, tack bolting edge gauge hole

body.en:
IS 800:2007 clause 10.2 specifies bolt spacing and edge/end distances. A common minimum pitch or gauge is 2.5d, where d is nominal bolt diameter. Minimum edge/end distance depends on hole diameter and the method of edge preparation: use the exact clause and applicable edge type. Maximum pitch, gauge and edge distance depend on thickness, tension/compression, exposure and whether members are in contact; consult clause 10.2 including its specific exceptions rather than memorising one value for every connection.

Distinguish bolt diameter d from hole diameter d₀ and follow the code’s clearance table. Provide adequate plate thickness, fit-up, access for tightening, corrosion protection and inspection. Check the actual staggered layout and end distances in the direction of force. The minimum geometric spacing alone does not establish connection capacity.
body.gu:
IS 800:2007 clause 10.2 માં bolt spacing અને edge/end distances નિર્ધારિત છે. સામાન્ય minimum pitch અથવા gauge 2.5d છે, જ્યાં d nominal bolt diameter છે. Minimum edge/end distance hole diameter અને edge preparation method પર આધારિત છે: ચોક્કસ clause અને edge type વાપરો. Maximum pitch, gauge અને edge distance thickness, tension/compression, exposure અને contact conditions પર આધારિત છે; clause 10.2 અને તેના exceptions તપાસો, દરેક connection માટે એક જ value ન માનો.

Bolt diameter d અને hole diameter d₀ અલગ રાખો તથા code clearance table અનુસરો. પૂરતી plate thickness, fit-up, tightening access, corrosion protection અને inspection આપો. Actual staggered layout અને force દિશાના end distances તપાસો. ફક્ત minimum spacing પૂરતું હોય તો પણ connection capacity સાબિત થતી નથી.

h.en: 2.3 Shear and bearing strength of bearing bolts
h.gu: 2.3 Bearing bolts ની shear અને bearing strength

items.syllabus_item: 2.2 Vdsb Vdpb bolt value joint efficiency

body.en:
Bolt shear: IS 800:2007 clause 10.3.3 uses bolt ultimate strength fub, the number of shear planes through threads or shank and their corresponding areas. For one threaded shear plane, Vdsb = fub Anb/(√3 γmb). For multiple planes use the sum nnAnb + nsAsb. Obtain thread tensile stress area Anb from the standard or the permitted approximation; shank area Asb = πd²/4.

Bearing: clause 10.3.4 uses Vdpb = 2.5 kb d t fu / γmb, with kb the least of e/(3d₀), p/(3d₀) − 0.25, fub/fu and 1.0; e and p are measured along load direction, t and fu correspond to the governing connected plate. Check all connected plies and applicable reductions. The bearing-bolt value is the smaller design shear and bearing resistance after applicable long-joint, large-grip or packing-plate reductions. Joint efficiency compares joint strength with the strength of the relevant unjointed member on the same basis; clearly define the comparison. Bolt group strength alone is not complete joint strength.
body.gu:
Bolt shear: IS 800:2007 clause 10.3.3 માં bolt ultimate strength fub, threads અથવા shank માંથી પસાર થતા shear planes ની સંખ્યા અને તેમની સંબંધિત areas વપરાય છે. એક threaded shear plane માટે Vdsb = fub Anb/(√3 γmb). અનેક planes માટે nnAnb + nsAsb નો સરવાળો લો. Thread tensile stress area Anb standard અથવા મંજૂર approximation પરથી લો; shank area Asb = πd²/4 છે.

Bearing: Clause 10.3.4 મુજબ Vdpb = 2.5 kb d t fu / γmb છે. kb એ e/(3d₀), p/(3d₀) − 0.25, fub/fu અને 1.0 માંથી સૌથી નાનું છે; e અને p load દિશામાં અને t તથા fu governing connected plate માટે છે. બધા connected plies અને લાગુ reductions તપાસો. Long-joint, large-grip અથવા packing-plate reductions પછી bearing bolt value = design shear અને bearing resistance માંથી નાનું. Joint efficiency માં joint strength ને સમાન basis પર સંબંધિત unjointed member strength સાથે સરખાવો; bolt-group strength એકલી સંપૂર્ણ joint strength નથી.

h.en: 2.4 Analysis and design of bolted plate and angle connections
h.gu: 2.4 Bolted plate અને angle connections નું analysis તથા design

items.syllabus_item: 2.3 plate and angle bolt connections in shear

body.en:
Start with factored force and the actual connection geometry. Choose bolt grade, diameter and hole, then check minimum and maximum distances and clearances. Calculate shear and bearing resistance per bolt, apply relevant reduction factors, and determine a preliminary bolt count by rounding upward. Arrange bolts so the force can be transferred to all connected parts; check plate gross yielding, net-section rupture, block shear, bearing of each ply and connection detailing.

For an angle connected through one leg, connection eccentricity, shear lag, gusset thickness and load distribution can matter. A simple equal-share calculation is only valid for the stated concentric assumptions; eccentric bolt groups need moment distribution. Check end distances, strength of the angle and gusset and other applicable limit states. HSFG bolts require slip-resistance and other checks appropriate to their design condition. A preliminary bolt count is not a complete structural design.
body.gu:
Factored force અને actual connection geometry થી શરૂઆત કરો. Bolt grade, diameter અને hole પસંદ કરી minimum/maximum distances તથા clearances તપાસો. દરેક bolt નું shear અને bearing resistance ગણો, લાગુ reduction factors લગાવો અને ઉપરની પૂર્ણ સંખ્યામાં preliminary bolt count લો. દરેક connected part સુધી force પહોંચે તેમ bolts ગોઠવો; plate gross yielding, net-section rupture, block shear, દરેક ply નું bearing અને detailing તપાસો.

એક leg થી જોડાયેલા angle માં connection eccentricity, shear lag, gusset thickness અને load distribution મહત્વના હોઈ શકે. Equal-share calculation ફક્ત દર્શાવેલી concentric assumptions માટે છે; eccentric bolt group માં moment distribution જરૂરી છે. End distances, angle તથા gusset strength અને અન્ય લાગુ limit states તપાસો. HSFG bolts માટે design condition મુજબ slip resistance અને અન્ય checks જરૂરી છે. Preliminary bolt count સંપૂર્ણ structural design નથી.

h.en: 2.5 Fillet welds: types, symbols, throat and detailing
h.gu: 2.5 Fillet welds: પ્રકારો, symbols, throat અને detailing

items.syllabus_item: 2.4 types of weld fillet symbol tack size throat end returns

body.en:
Common welds are fillet and butt/groove welds. A fillet weld joins surfaces approximately at right angles; the weld symbol and drawing identify the joint, side, size and length. Tack welds temporarily hold the parts in alignment and are treated according to fabrication requirements. For a 90° equal-leg fillet, the effective throat is approximately 0.7 times the leg size s. The effective throat factor depends on the included angle; do not use 0.7 for every geometry.

Minimum fillet size depends on the thicker part and code table; maximum size depends on thinner part, edge condition and code provisions. End returns, effective length and minimum effective length must meet the applicable IS 800 requirements. For an ordinary fillet weld the effective length is generally the overall length minus twice the weld size unless special end details apply; effective length should not be less than four times the weld size. Inspect access, preparation, continuity, distortion and corrosion protection.
body.gu:
સામાન્ય welds માં fillet અને butt/groove welds છે. Fillet weld લગભગ સમકોણ surfaces જોડે છે; weld symbol અને drawing joint, side, size તથા length દર્શાવે છે. Tack welds parts ને alignment માં હંગામી રીતે રાખે છે અને fabrication requirements મુજબ વર્તે છે. 90° equal-leg fillet માટે effective throat આશરે leg size s ના 0.7 ગણો છે. Throat factor included angle પર આધારિત છે; 0.7 દરેક geometry માટે ન વાપરો.

Minimum fillet size જાડા part અને code table પર; maximum size પાતળા part, edge condition અને code provisions પર આધારિત છે. End returns, effective length અને minimum effective length લાગુ IS 800 requirements સંતોષે તે જરૂરી છે. સામાન્ય fillet weld માટે special end details સિવાય effective length = overall length − 2 × weld size; effective length ચાર ગણાં weld size કરતાં ઓછી ન હોવી જોઈએ. Access, preparation, continuity, distortion અને corrosion protection તપાસો.

h.en: 2.6 Fillet weld design for plates and angles
h.gu: 2.6 Plates અને angles માટે fillet weld design

items.syllabus_item: 2.5 analysis and design of fillet weld in plate and angle

body.en:
For the simple case of a uniform, concentric weld group, the design weld stress fwd is based on the lower ultimate strength of weld metal and parent metal divided by √3 γmw; use the appropriate shop or site γmw and code provisions. Design strength is effective throat × effective length × fwd. For two equal parallel weld lines carrying a concentric force, sum their effective lengths, then convert each effective length to overall length with the applicable end allowance.

For an angle welded by one leg, weld lines may need unequal lengths to align their resultant with the member force and reduce eccentricity. If the load is eccentric, check the weld group under combined direct and moment effects; equal force per unit length is not generally valid. Check weld minimum/maximum sizes, length, end returns, plate/angle strength, gusset, distortion and load path. Numerical examples are preliminary, not a complete fabrication design.
body.gu:
સરળ uniform અને concentric weld group માટે design weld stress fwd, weld metal અને parent metal ની ultimate strengths માંથી ઓછી કિંમતને √3 γmw થી ભાગીને મળે છે; યોગ્ય shop અથવા site γmw અને code provisions લો. Design strength = effective throat × effective length × fwd. Concentric force ધરાવતા બે સમાન parallel weld lines માટે તેમની effective lengths ઉમેરો, પછી લાગુ end allowance થી દરેક overall length શોધો.

એક leg થી weld કરેલા angle માં weld lines ની resultant ને member force સાથે ગોઠવી eccentricity ઘટાડવા જુદી lengths જરૂરી હોઈ શકે. Load eccentric હોય તો weld group માં direct અને moment effects સાથે તપાસો; પ્રતિ unit length સમાન force સામાન્ય રીતે યોગ્ય નથી. Weld minimum/maximum size, length, end returns, plate/angle strength, gusset, distortion અને load path તપાસો. Numerical examples preliminary છે, સંપૂર્ણ fabrication design નથી.

title.en: Numerical 2.1 — Bearing bolt shear and bearing
title.gu: Numerical 2.1 — Bearing bolt ની shear અને bearing

body.en:
Given: A bearing-type M20 grade 4.6 bolt connects 10 mm plate in single shear with threads in the shear plane. Given Anb = 245 mm², d₀ = 22 mm, end distance e = 40 mm, pitch p = 60 mm, fub = 400 MPa, plate fu = 410 MPa and γmb = 1.25. Calculate the unreduced bolt value; assume no long-joint, large-grip or packing reduction.

Step 1. Find design shear strength.

Vdsb = fub Anb / (√3 γmb)Vdsb = 400 × 245 / (√3 × 1.25)Vdsb ≈ 45.26 kN

Step 2. Calculate the four bearing coefficients and select the smallest.

e / (3d₀) = 40 / (3 × 22)e / (3d₀) = 0.606p / (3d₀) − 0.25 = 60 / (3 × 22) − 0.25p / (3d₀) − 0.25 = 0.659fub / fu = 400 / 410fub / fu = 0.976kb = min(0.606, 0.659, 0.976, 1.0)kb = 0.606

Step 3. Calculate bearing strength and take the lesser value.

Vdpb = 2.5 kb d t fu / γmbVdpb = 2.5 × (40/66) × 20 × 10 × 410 / 1.25Vdpb ≈ 99.39 kNBolt value = min(45.26, 99.39)

Final answer:

Bolt value ≈ 45.26 kN, governed by shear. Check all connected plies and detailing separately.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Bearing-type M20 grade 4.6 bolt, 10 mm plate ને single shear માં જોડે છે અને shear plane threads માંથી જાય છે. Anb = 245 mm², d₀ = 22 mm, end distance e = 40 mm, pitch p = 60 mm, fub = 400 MPa, plate fu = 410 MPa અને γmb = 1.25 છે. Long-joint, large-grip કે packing reduction નથી એમ માની unreduced bolt value ગણો.

Step 1. Design shear strength શોધો.

Vdsb = fub Anb / (√3 γmb)Vdsb = 400 × 245 / (√3 × 1.25)Vdsb ≈ 45.26 kN

Step 2. ચાર bearing coefficients ગણી સૌથી નાનું પસંદ કરો.

e / (3d₀) = 40 / (3 × 22)e / (3d₀) = 0.606p / (3d₀) − 0.25 = 60 / (3 × 22) − 0.25p / (3d₀) − 0.25 = 0.659fub / fu = 400 / 410fub / fu = 0.976kb = min(0.606, 0.659, 0.976, 1.0)kb = 0.606

Step 3. Bearing strength ગણી ઓછી કિંમત લો.

Vdpb = 2.5 kb d t fu / γmbVdpb = 2.5 × (40/66) × 20 × 10 × 410 / 1.25Vdpb ≈ 99.39 kNBolt value = min(45.26, 99.39)

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Bolt value ≈ 45.26 kN, shear governing છે. બધા connected plies અને detailing અલગ તપાસો.

title.gu: Numerical 2.2 — Preliminary bolt count ની ગણતરી

body.en:
Given: A concentric connection transfers 120 kN factored shear. Each bolt has an applicable design value of 45.26 kN. Estimate the minimum number, assuming equal load sharing and no group reduction.

Step 1. Divide required force by bolt value.

Required number = 120 / 45.26Required number ≈ 2.65

Step 2. Round up to whole bolts.

Number of bolts = 3Bolt group resistance = 3 × 45.26Bolt group resistance = 135.78 kN

Final answer:

Use at least 3 bolts for this preliminary shear check; plate, block shear, detailing and eccentricity require separate checks.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Concentric connection માં factored shear 120 kN છે. દરેક bolt ની લાગુ design value 45.26 kN છે. Equal load sharing અને group reduction નહીં એમ માની minimum સંખ્યા શોધો.

Step 1. જરૂરી force ને bolt value થી ભાગો.

Required number = 120 / 45.26Required number ≈ 2.65

Step 2. ઉપરની સંપૂર્ણ bolt સંખ્યા લો.

Number of bolts = 3Bolt group resistance = 3 × 45.26Bolt group resistance = 135.78 kN

અંતિમ જવાબ:

આ preliminary shear check માટે ઓછામાં ઓછા 3 bolts; plate, block shear, detailing અને eccentricity અલગ તપાસો.

title.gu: Numerical 2.3 — Concentric fillet weld ની ગણતરી

body.en:
Given: Two equal parallel shop fillet welds connect plates for a concentric factored shear of 120 kN. Weld size s = 6 mm; weaker ultimate strength fu = 410 MPa and γmw = 1.25. Assume 90° fillets and overall length minus 2s per line; choose 92 mm overall per line and check weld strength only.

Step 1. Calculate throat and design weld stress.

Effective throat = 0.7 × 6Effective throat = 4.2 mmfwd = 410 / (√3 × 1.25)fwd ≈ 189.37 N/mm²

Step 2. Calculate effective length.

Effective length per line = 92 − 2 × 6Effective length per line = 80 mmTotal effective length = 2 × 80Total effective length = 160 mm

Step 3. Find weld resistance.

Weld resistance = 4.2 × 160 × 189.37Weld resistance ≈ 127.26 kN

Final answer:

127.26 kN exceeds 120 kN for the stated weld-strength check. Check size limits, detailing, connected parts and eccentricity separately.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: બે સમાન parallel shop fillet welds દ્વારા plates માં 120 kN concentric factored shear પહોંચે છે. Weld size s = 6 mm, ઓછી ultimate strength fu = 410 MPa અને γmw = 1.25 છે. 90° fillets અને line દીઠ effective length = overall length − 2s માની દરેક line માટે 92 mm overall લો અને ફક્ત weld strength તપાસો.

Step 1. Throat અને design weld stress ગણો.

Effective throat = 0.7 × 6Effective throat = 4.2 mmfwd = 410 / (√3 × 1.25)fwd ≈ 189.37 N/mm²

Step 2. Effective length ગણો.

Effective length per line = 92 − 2 × 6Effective length per line = 80 mmTotal effective length = 2 × 80Total effective length = 160 mm

Step 3. Weld resistance શોધો.

Weld resistance = 4.2 × 160 × 189.37Weld resistance ≈ 127.26 kN

અંતિમ જવાબ:

આપેલ weld-strength check માં 127.26 kN, 120 kN કરતાં વધુ છે. Size limits, detailing, connected parts અને eccentricity અલગ તપાસો.

name.gu: Bearing bolt અને fillet weld ના સૂત્રો
